bookTitle: Technical Analysis of the Financial Markets

facts.statement: The symmetrical triangle, or coil, is a neutral consolidation pattern defined by two converging trendlines representing market equilibrium before trend resumption.

sourceCitation.book: Technical Analysis of the Financial Markets
sourceCitation.excerpt: The symmetrical triangle (also called a coil) is a consolidation pattern bounded by two converging trendlines

facts.statement: A valid symmetrical triangle requires at least four reversal points, typically developing into six reversal points comprising five internal corrective waves.

sourceCitation.book: Technical Analysis of the Financial Markets
sourceCitation.excerpt: Minimum Requirement: At least 4 reversal points... 6 reversal points (three peaks and three troughs)

facts.statement: The base height of a triangle pattern is calculated by subtracting the lowest initial trough price from the highest initial peak price at the baseline.

sourceCitation.book: Technical Analysis of the Financial Markets
sourceCitation.excerpt: Base Height (H): H = P(peak, base) - P(trough, base)

variables.definition: price at the highest initial peak

facts.statement: The vertical price target for a breakout is determined by adding or subtracting the pattern's base height from the exact breakout price level.

sourceCitation.book: Technical Analysis of the Financial Markets
sourceCitation.excerpt: Vertical Price Objective (P_target): P_target = P_breakout + H

variables.definition: price level where trendline penetration occurs

facts.statement: Pattern breakouts require a decisive closing penetration outside the trendline and must be accompanied by a noticeable expansion in trading volume.

sourceCitation.book: Technical Analysis of the Financial Markets
sourceCitation.excerpt: Requires a decisive close outside either trendline... surge in volume is mandatory

facts.statement: Dell Computer Corp formed an 18-week wide daily bullish symmetrical triangle in late 1997, breaking out during the thirteenth week beyond the two-thirds point.

sourceCitation.book: Technical Analysis of the Financial Markets
sourceCitation.excerpt: Dell Computer Corp (Q4 1997): Formed an 18-week wide bullish symmetrical triangle

facts.statement: An ascending triangle features a flat horizontal upper resistance line and a rising lower support line, reflecting buyer aggressiveness at higher lows.

sourceCitation.book: Technical Analysis of the Financial Markets
sourceCitation.excerpt: ascending triangle is bounded by a flat upper resistance trendline and a rising lower support trendline

facts.statement: Ascending triangles are inherently bullish continuation or major bottoming patterns that resolve upward through fixed overhead resistance.

sourceCitation.book: Technical Analysis of the Financial Markets
sourceCitation.excerpt: inherently bullish pattern... continuation pattern... major bottoming pattern

facts.statement: A descending triangle is characterized by a descending upper trendline and a flat horizontal lower support line, indicating aggressive seller pressure.

sourceCitation.book: Technical Analysis of the Financial Markets
sourceCitation.excerpt: descending triangle is the mirror image... descending upper trendline and a flat lower support line

facts.statement: Descending triangles are inherently bearish patterns acting as downtrend continuations or top reversals upon downside support penetration.

sourceCitation.book: Technical Analysis of the Financial Markets
sourceCitation.excerpt: inherently bearish pattern... continuation pattern within downtrends, or market tops

facts.statement: The Dow Transportation Index demonstrated a daily bullish ascending triangle in late 1997 with a horizontal ceiling established at the 3400 price level.

sourceCitation.book: Technical Analysis of the Financial Markets
sourceCitation.excerpt: Dow Transportation Index (Late 1997): Formed a bullish ascending triangle... resistance ceiling at 3400

facts.statement: Breakouts from triangle patterns typically occur between two-thirds and three-quarters of the horizontal distance from the baseline to the apex.

sourceCitation.book: Technical Analysis of the Financial Markets
sourceCitation.excerpt: The 2/3 to 3/4 Apex Time Limit Rule... breakout in [2/3 W, 3/4 W]

facts.statement: Following a breakout, broken triangle trendlines and pattern apexes act as future support or resistance levels during subsequent market return moves.

sourceCitation.book: Technical Analysis of the Financial Markets
sourceCitation.excerpt: Broken trendlines convert to support or resistance on return moves, and the apex serves as a vital future support/resistance level

facts.statement: Du Pont formed a daily bearish descending triangle in autumn 1997, featuring a declining upper boundary and breaking down decisively in early October.

sourceCitation.book: Technical Analysis of the Financial Markets
sourceCitation.excerpt: Du Pont (Autumn 1997): Developed a daily bearish descending triangle... broke down in early October 1997

generalAssumptions: Market action discounts all known and unknown fundamentals.
Prices move in trends, and a trend in motion is more likely to continue than to reverse.
